items.text: Patriots downgrade A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) to OUT for Sunday vs Dolphins; knee flared after limited Wednesday.
items.why: Knee issue flared; DNP Thu/Fri after limited Wed; official team downgrade.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; Pats WR depth thins, elevates practice-squad candidates.

items.text: Patriots rule TreVeyon Henderson (illness) OUT vs Dolphins after DNP Thu/Fri.
items.why: Illness; missed final two practices; official OUT.
items.implication: Rhamondre Stevenson full workload; handcuff value spikes short-term.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) listed IN / not on final report; expected to play vs Bills with minor rushing docks.
items.why: Full participant earlier; no final designation; Rapoport/ETR confirm back.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens passing attack; Flowers upgrade.
items.opportunity: Full snap share expected; small rush volume reduction.

items.text: Colts now open to trading star RB Jonathan Taylor; talks ongoing and active (joint with Schefter).
items.why: Sources confirm willingness and active discussions pre-deadline.
items.implication: Monitor landing spot for ROS value shift; short-term uncertainty.

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) not on final injury report; hard to believe 100% but he's playing.
items.why: Cleared final report despite recent hamstring/back issues; ETR lists IN.
items.implication: Start with caution on workload; reverse prior handcuff priority.
items.opportunity: Full role expected if healthy enough.
items.conflict: Berry hates due to usage concerns.

items.text: RJ Harvey (knee) OUT; unique role has no clean replacement but frees 3-6 targets; Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Knee; ETR OUT board; Levitan notes target vacancy.
items.implication: Broncos pass-catcher opportunity expands if Waddle limited.
items.opportunity: 3-6 extra targets available in DEN offense.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) Q again; cryptic faith tweet + trade rumors circulating; thought close last week.
items.why: Quad lingering; cryptic social + trade buzz; ETR Q.
items.implication: Monitor active; Braelon Allen continues if inactive.
items.opportunity: If out, Allen bellcow; if in, timeshare risk.
items.conflict: Berry loves both Hall/Allen vs LV.

items.text: Taken Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) out of projections; fallout visible in updated ETR numbers.
items.why: Concussion + foot; ETR/Levitan removed from projs.
items.implication: Bucs WR targets redistribute; Godwin/others up.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining TB WRs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs taking Ashton Jeanty path of strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 inside-5 carries + 13 targets in 2 games post-suspension.
items.why: Goal-line + target volume driving value independent of efficiency.
items.implication: Start confidently; parallel to Jeanty as volume RB.

items.text: Zay Flowers is WR5 this week; LOVE with Lamar Jackson expected back unlocking the Ravens offense vs Bills track-meet potential.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and red-zone with Jackson.

items.text: RB LOVE: Derrick Henry (RB6 @BUF), Chase Brown (RB8 vs TEN), Josh Jacobs (RB11 vs CAR); HATE: Saquon Barkley (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB21), Omarion Hampton (RB34).
items.why: Soft run defenses for loves; usage/role/underdog concerns for hates.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Barkley playing despite residual issues.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on HATE list; production lacking and Chiefs have allowed just one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Tough KC secondary + recent underperformance; also Q (chest).
items.conflict: Harvey OUT could free targets if active.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE both weeks) in 2 games since Caleb Williams return; leads TE utilization.
items.why: Sustained high target share post-Williams return.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins set season lows in snap rate (51.5%) and target share (3%) with Dylan Sampson back from IR; passing-game role takes significant hit (was 13.6% without him).
items.why: Sampson return compresses Judkins' receiving work.
items.implication: Still majority touches but lower ceiling; Levitan sell-high note aligns.
